The upstream skill is installed at ~/.codex/skills/impeccable for development. Selected original references are archived here for collaborators; they are development guidance, not runtime report prompts or knowledge evidence. This pass applies the Operate/Read, audit, layout and polish guidance to the existing UI and verifies results with the existing browser tooling.

The initial context launcher did not execute because the installer did not retain its executable bit. The documented fallback was used: project context and references were read directly. No deterministic detector run or accessibility certification is claimed. The launcher permission is corrected for later sessions, without rerunning the failed context step in this session.
